description: This file defines a SwiftUI view component called 'TalkOverlayView' along with several supporting views and classes to render and manage an overlay interface, likely for a communication or voice application. It includes interactive elements, animations, and custom drawing for a talk mode interface.

classes.name: OrbInteractionNSView
classes.description: A custom NSView handling mouse interactions for single clicks, double clicks, and drag events within the overlay.

methods.name: makeNSView
methods.description: Creates and configures the NSView implementing the interaction behavior.

methods.name: updateNSView
methods.description: Updates the existing NSView with new handlers for interaction events.

methods.name: mouseDown
methods.description: Handles mouse down events, detecting double clicks and starting drag operations.

methods.name: mouseDragged
methods.description: Handles drag motion events, initiating window dragging.

methods.name: mouseUp
methods.description: Handles mouse release events, triggering single click actions if appropriate.
